title: Jesus... Starting Over At 30 Feels Like Admitting I Failed. 🌱
topic: at thirty he is restarting his career from the bottom and calls the fresh start an admission of failure

bible.text: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... starting over at 30 feels like admitting I failed. 🌱

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Everyone calls it brave. Nobody mentions how heavy the first step is.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: A restart isn't a verdict on your past. It's a page I'm still writing.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But what if this attempt fails like the last one did?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're not starting from zero. You're starting from everything I taught you.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: The old chapter taught you. This one doesn't have to repeat it.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend starting over this year. 🌱
